serverInfo.name: plopino
serverInfo.title: Plopino
serverInfo.description: Publish an HTML page, a document, or a folder to Plopino and get a public link.

tools.name: publish_html
tools.title: Publish an HTML page and get a link
tools.description: Publish an HTML page to a public URL. Use this whenever the user asks to share, send, publish, or "give me a link to" a page — a dashboard, report, chart, or interactive page. Returns a public link that opens on any device; no account or configuration needed. Anonymous pages are kept for a month — with a token, storage is permanent and the page can be updated in place.

html.description: The complete HTML document to publish, including the <html> tag. Must be self-contained: relative references to local files will not resolve — use publish_path when the page needs sibling files.

update_url.description: A URL returned by an earlier publish. When given, that page content is replaced and the link stays the same. Requires a Plopino token.

url.description: Public link to the published page.

note.description: Human-readable status: created vs updated, and how long the page is kept.

tools.name: publish_path
tools.title: Publish a local file or folder and get a link
tools.description: Publish a local file, a zip, or a whole directory to a public URL, preserving the directory structure. Use this when the page needs sibling files (CSS, JS, images) or to share any document: Word (doc/docx), Excel (xls/xlsx) and Markdown render as readable pages, code and data files get syntax-highlighted previews, images and video display inline.

path.description: Absolute path to a file or directory on this machine. Directories upload recursively (symbolic links skipped); zips are unpacked server-side.

update_url.description: A URL returned by an earlier publish. When given, that page content is replaced and the link stays the same. Requires a Plopino token.

url.description: Public link to the published page.

note.description: Human-readable status: created vs updated, and how long the page is kept.
